evidence: The authors' public file contained 729 learner–problem records. On 584 matched out-of-time learner-held-out observations, first-correct F1 was 0.676 for the past-only model. In the independent code archive, 27 incorrect programs removed from the list being traversed.
next_decision: Use the two interactive feedback variants for a future learner-randomized study. Historical hint use is observational and cannot measure which prototype improves independent transfer.
boundary: The public CSEDM example describes a subset of the 89-learner, 38-task source cohort. It contains aggregated learner/problem outcomes. Actual code examples are from the independent Refactory study. No newly delivered hint or transfer improvement is attributed to either cohort.
